APL 移动豁免耐伤
裔兵持徽手
2 6" 5+ 7
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
大刀 4 4+ 3/5 -
教派徽记：在确定这名特工 4" 内一个标识的控制
时，若至少有一名己方族群裔兵特工在争夺那个标
识，则将争夺中的己方族群裔兵特工 APL 属性视
作提升 1 点，请注意这并非对 APL 属性的修正，所
以任何修正都会与这一效果累加。
忠于族群意志：每个转折点一次，当一名就绪且可
见的己方族群裔兵特工在这名特工 6" 内残废时，
您可以使用这个规则。若这么做，那么直到那名特
工被移出杀戮区前，特工可以无消耗执行一个消耗
1AP 的行动（近战和爆炸除外)，并且您在这么做
时可以更改特工的指令。之后它按正常流程被移出
杀戮区，您不能在使用这个规则的同时使用“医务
兵！”规则（见医务兵数据卡）。
族群裔兵、基因窃取者教派、泰伦虫族、族群护卫、持徽手 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
BROOD BROTHER ICONWARD
2 6" 5+ 7
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Large knife 4 4+ 3/5 -
Cult Icon: Whenever determining control of a marker within 4"
of this operative, treat the total APL stat of friendly BROOD
BROTHER operatives that contest it as 1 higher if at least one
friendly BROOD BROTHER operative contests that marker.
Note this isn’t a change to the APL stat, so any changes are
cumulative with this.
Broodmind Devotion: Once per turning point, when a ready
friendly BROOD BROTHER BROODGUARD operative
is incapacitated while visible to and within 6" of this operative,
you can use this rule. If you do, before that operative is removed
from the killzone, it can perform a 1AP action for free (excluding
Fight and Explosives), and you can change its order to do so.
It’s then removed from the killzone as normal. You cannot use
this rule and the Medic! rule (see MEDIC) on the same operative
at the same time.
BROOD BROTHER , TYRANID, GENESTEALER CULT, BROODGUARD, ICONWARD 25

裔兵医务兵 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 7

激光枪 4 4+ 2/3 -
刺刀 3 4+ 2/3 -
基因毒针枪 1 4+ 5/7 致命 5+，有限 1
医务兵！：在每个转折点中，首次出现位于这名特工 3" 内且可见的另一名己方族群裔兵特工（族长除
外）将被残废时，如果该特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规则。若使
用，那么那名己方特工不会被残废，并且剩余 1 点耐伤并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那次行动结束
后，那名己方特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束这次移动。
直到该特工和那名特工的下一次激活结束前，他们的 APL 属性各减少 1 点。如果您在那名特工的激活期间
使用了本规则，那么那次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主
要或次要目标时使用此规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
族群裔兵、基因窃取者教派、泰伦虫族、族群护卫、医务兵 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
BROOD BROTHER MEDIC
2 6" 5+ 7
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Lasgun 4 4+ 2/3 -
Bayonet 3 4+ 2/3 -
Gene-needler 1 4+ 5/7 Lethal 5+, Limited 1
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly BROOD BROTHER operative (excluding PATRIARCH)
would be incapacitated while visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is
within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be
incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action,
but must end that move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their
next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use
this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
BROOD BROTHER , TYRANID, GENESTEALER CULT, BROODGUARD, MEDIC 25

工第二次执行这个行动时，那枚标记 2" 内的每
一名特工受到 2D6 点伤害（为每一名特工分开

cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
BROOD BROTHER SAPPER
2 6" 5+ 7
EXPLOSIVES 1AP
The first time this operative performs this action during the
battle, place your Explosives marker within its control range.
The second time this operative performs this action during
the battle, inflict 2D6 damage on each operative within 2" of
that marker (roll separately for each) unless Heavy terrain is
wholly intervening between that operative and that marker.
This operative cannot perform this action more than twice
per battle, while within control range of an enemy operative,
or during an activation in which it performed the Charge,
Dash or Fall Back action (or vice versa).

火力和同步攻击。
每当一名己方族群裔兵特工对一名敌方特工进

指示物。您每移除一枚指示物，便可以重掷一枚
己方攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FACTION RULE
CROSSFIRE
Combined with their advanced coordination skills, the
professional training and high-grade weapons of Brood
Brothers make them a deadly threat. With a sinister
synchronicity born of the alien Broodmind that worms
through their psyche, these soldiers are capable of a
concentration of firepower or a harmonising of blows
that is ferociously effective.
Whenever a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
is shooting against or fighting against an enemy
operative, after resolving all of your attack dice, if
that enemy operative isn’t incapacitated it gains
one of your Crossfire tokens.
Whenever a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
is shooting against, fighting against or retaliating
against an enemy operative that has any of your
Crossfire tokens, you can remove any of those
tokens. For each that you do, you can re-roll one
of your attack dice.

叛逆

能在施展背刺前靠近敌人。
每一名己方族群裔兵特工在其激活中首次执行

次激活的射击和近战行动中使用）。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
STRATEGY PLOY
UPRISING
Appearing at first to be allied troops, the Brood Brothers
close in on their foes before revealing their treachery.
The first time each friendly BROOD BROTHER
operative performs either the Shoot or Fight
action during each of its activations, if its order
was changed from Conceal to Engage at the start
of that activation, the enemy operative selected
as the valid target or to fight against gains one
of your Crossfire tokens as soon as it’s selected
(instead of after resolving your attack dice).
This ploy has no effect if that friendly operative
was activated within control range of an enemy
operative. Note this ploy cannot come into effect
more than once per activation (you cannot use
it during both the Shoot and Fight action in the
same activation).

cards.text:
族群裔兵
战略计谋
驻防
族群裔兵对自己的交战环境非常熟悉——他们
占据的点位能帮助自己在面对火力时获得最
佳防护。
每当一名敌方特工对一名己方族群裔兵特工进
行射击时，若您因为重型地形保留了任意掩护豁
免，则您可以额外保留一枚掩护豁免。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
STRATEGY PLOY
EMBEDDED
Brood Brothers are intimately familiar with the
battlefields upon which they fight, taking up positions
that offer greatest protection from incoming fire.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a
friendly BROOD BROTHER operative, if you
can retain any cover saves as a result of Heavy
terrain, you can retain one additional cover save.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
战略计谋
忠于教派
族群裔兵对教派是如此狂热，他们甘愿献出生
命换取对敌人的有力打击。
每当一名己方族群裔兵特工（族长除外）在近
战或反击中残废，若您有任意未结算的成功，您
可以掷一枚 D6：若掷骰结果在那次流程的掷攻
击骰步骤中为成功结果（即使用相同的武器属性
但不使用重掷），则您可以使用一枚那次流程中
未结算的普通成功进行出击，若 D6 掷骰结果为
关键成功，则您可以使用任意未结算的成功进行
出击。在结算以上两种情况后，将那名己方特工
从杀戮区中移除。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
STRATEGY PLOY
CULT DEVOTION
Such is their devotion to the Cult’s cause that Brood
Brothers will gladly trade their lives to land a telling blow
upon their oppressors.
Whenever a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
(excluding PATRIARCH) is incapacitated while
fighting or retaliating, if you have any unresolved
successes, you can roll one D6: if the result is
a success as if it were the Roll Attack Dice step
of that sequence (i.e. using the same weapon,
but with no re-rolls), you can strike the enemy
operative in that sequence with one of your
unresolved normal successes, or any of your
successes instead if the D6 result is a critical
success. In either case, that friendly operative is
removed from the killzone afterwards.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
交战计谋
无情协调
族群思维能使族群裔兵组成的杀戮小队沟通无
间，使得他们之间的火力协调极为精准。
在为一名己方族群裔兵特工选择有效目标时使
用此交战计谋。直到那次行动结束前，您可以正
常按视野确定有效目标，但也可以通过对那名己
方特工和潜在有效目标均可见的，且不在敌方特
工控制范围内的另一名己方族群裔兵特工介入
判断（用于确定是否存在掩护或遮挡）。
请注意，另一名特工位于制高点上并不会使那名
己方特工获得额外增益（例如：以拥有隐匿命令
且仅被轻型地形提供掩护的敌方特工为目标）。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
RUTHLESS COORDINATION
The Broodmind allows for incredibly precise
communication and coordinated fire between the
members of a Brood Brothers kill team.
Use this firefight ploy when selecting a valid
target for a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative.
Until the end of the action, determine visibility
as normal, but you can instead determine
intervening (for cover and obscured) from
another friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
that both that friendly operative and the potential
valid target are visible to, but that isn’t itself
within control range of enemy operatives.
Note the friendly operative doesn’t gain the
additional benefits of Vantage terrain if the other
friendly operative is on it (e.g. to target an enemy
operative that has a Conceal order that’s in cover
provided only by Light terrain).
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
族群裔兵
交战计谋
忠心耿耿
军事训练巩固了教派的森严等级。级别较低的
族群裔兵会用身体抵挡子弹或利刃，以保护
其领袖。
当一名己方族群裔兵队长特工被选择进行近战
行动或成为射击行动目标时使用此交战计谋。选
择对那名队长特工可见且位于其 3" 内的另一名
族群裔兵族群护卫特工（队长除外）作为这次
近战或射击行动的替代目标（即便通常情况它无
法成为有效目标）。如果这是近战行动，则将那
名特工视为在那次行动中处于近战特工的控制范
围内。若那是一次射击行动，那么其他特工只
有在原本目标拥有掩护或被遮挡时才能拥有对应
的效果。
如果那次行动为射击行动且对应的远程武器拥
有“爆炸”或“洪流”武器规则，则本计谋没有
效果。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNQUESTIONING LOYALTY
The Cult’s rigid hierarchy is reinforced by military
training. Lower ranking Brood Brothers will stand in the
way of bullets or blades to protect their leaders.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly BROOD
BROTHER LEADER operative is selected as the
valid target of a Shoot action or to fight against
during the Fight action. Select one other friendly
BROOD BROTHER BROODGUARD operative
(excluding LEADER) visible to and within 3" of
that LEADER operative to become the valid target
or to be fought against (as appropriate) instead
(even if it wouldn’t normally be valid for this). If
it’s the Fight action, treat that other operative as
being within the fighting operative’s control range
for the duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot
action, that other operative is only in cover or
obscured if the original target was.
This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action
and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
交战计谋
崇拜
教派领袖会利用族群思维的灵能给予其追随者
启迪之力。
在一名己方族群裔兵特工（队长除外）进行射
击，近战或反击的掷攻击骰步骤中，若一名己方
族群裔兵队长特工或族群裔兵持徽者特工位于
那名己方特工 6" 内，您便可使用此交战计谋。
若此，您便可以将一枚失败结果改为普通成功，
或是将一枚普通成功改为一枚关键成功。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
IDOLISATION
The Cult’s leaders use the psionic power of the
Broodmind to provide powerful inspiration to
their followers.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly BROOD
BROTHER operative (excluding LEADER) within
6" of a friendly BROOD BROTHER LEADER
or BROOD BROTHER ICONWARD operative
is shooting, fighting or retaliating, in the Roll
Attack Dice step. You can retain one of your fails
as a normal success instead of discarding it, or
retain one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
交战计谋
狡诈
族群裔兵依靠伏击和突袭击败敌人，他们往往
会在攻击后立即撤退并进行重新部署。
在一次激活后使用此交战计谋。在下次激活前，
一名己方族群裔兵特工可以执行一次无消耗的
冲刺行动，但在那次行动的开始和结束时它不能
成为敌方特工的有效目标。您不能在第一转折点
中使用本计谋。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
INSIDIOUS
Brood Brothers rely upon ambush and surprise to defeat
their enemies, retreating and repositioning as required.
Use this firefight ploy after an activation.
Before the next activation, one friendly BROOD
BROTHER operative can perform a free Dash
action, as long as it’s not a valid target for
enemy operatives when it starts and ends that
action. You cannot use this ploy during the first
turning point.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
阵营装备
教派护符
教派非常重视被注入了族长力量的饰物或护
符，这些物品被认为能够保护持有者。
每个转折点一次，当一名特工对一名己方族群裔
兵特工（族长除外）进行射击时，在掷防御骰
步骤结束时，您可以将一枚己方普通成功保留为
一枚关键成功。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CULT TALISMAN
The Cult places great importance on trinkets and
talismans infused with the Patriarch’s power. These
items are believed to offer protection to the bearer.
Once per turning point, when an operative is
shooting a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
(excluding PATRIARCH), in the Roll Defence Dice
step, you can retain one of your normal successes
as a critical success instead.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
阵营装备
秘密伪装
族群裔兵们能以人类身份生活相当长时间，足
够用来接近那些毫无防备的敌人。
在揭示装备选项后，掷一枚 D3。作为第一个转
折点的战略计划，数量等同于掷骰结果，且完全
位于己方降落区的己方族群裔兵族群护卫特工
可以立即进行一次无消耗的转移行动，但必须在
完全位于己方降落区 3" 内的位置结束移动。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COVERT GUISES
Brood Brothers are able to pass as Human long enough
to close upon their unsuspecting enemies.
After revealing this equipment option, roll one
D3. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning
point, a number of friendly BROOD BROTHER
BROODGUARD operatives equal to the result that
are wholly within your drop zone can immediately
perform a free Reposition action, but must end
that move wholly within 3" of your drop zone.

cards.text:
族群裔兵
阵营装备
教派匕首
族群裔兵装备着各种非常规武器，其中包括了
各种装点着异形教派纹路的匕首。
己方族群裔兵族群护卫特工获得下列近战武
器：
名称攻击命中伤害
教派匕首 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CULT KNIVES
Brood Brothers wield an array of nonstandard
weapons, including various knives decorated with
xenocult iconography.
Friendly BROOD BROTHER BROODGUARD
operatives have the following melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Cult knife 3 4+ 3/4

cards.text:
族群裔兵
阵营装备
警戒守望
族群裔兵们尖锐的眼神能辨别出偷摸潜入的敌
人，并为其点上代表毁灭的标记。
战略计划。选择一名对己方族群裔兵特工可见
的敌方特工，令其获得一枚己方交叉火力指示
物。
cards.text_en:
BROOD BROTHER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
LOOKOUT
The Brood Brothers’ keen eyes pick out encroaching
foes and mark them for annihilation.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one enemy operative
visible to a friendly BROOD BROTHER operative
to gain one of your Crossfire tokens.
